title: 2010 Chile earthquake
summary: A magnitude-8.8 earthquake struck off the coast of south-central Chile, causing widespread damage and a tsunami that devastated some coastal areas. Together they caused more than 500 deaths, and nearly 400,000 homes were damaged. It was the strongest in the region since the 1960 event.
